h1: Custom Fleece Shirts for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom fleece shirts for your team or event. Perfect for cold weather branding. Get a quote from Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: When the temperature drops, cotton t-shirts won’t cut it. Custom fleece shirts offer the warmth and comfort your team needs while keeping your branding front and center. Whether you’re outfitting employees for a winter trade show or rewarding volunteers with a cozy layer, fleece provides a soft, durable surface that takes screen printing or embroidery cleanly. Choose from pullovers, quarter-zips, or full-zip styles in a range of weights suitable for mild or bitter cold.
